title: CFP® Certification (Certified Financial Planner)
body: Certified Financial Planner Board of Standards (CFP Board)
source: CFP Board Principal Knowledge Domains & Standards of Conduct
summary: The gold standard in holistic fiduciary personal financial planning, covering 7 core principal knowledge domains, a financial plan development Capstone, a 170-question computer-based exam, and 6,000 hours of qualifying experience.

standard.name: Standard Fiduciary Planning Pathway
standard.blurb: Complete registered education, pass the Capstone course, pass the 6-hour 170-MCQ Prometric exam, complete 6,000 hours experience, and commit to fiduciary ethics.

stages.title: Stage 1: Registered Education & Degree Prerequisite
stages.subtitle: Coursework across 7 core domains and Bachelor's degree verification

nodes.name: CFP Board Registered Education Program
nodes.description: Complete accredited educational coursework covering the Principal Knowledge Domains: General Principles, Risk Management & Insurance, Investment Planning, Tax Planning, Retirement Planning, Estate Planning, and Psychology of Financial Planning.

nodes.name: Bachelor's Degree Requirement
nodes.description: Hold a Bachelor's degree (or higher) in any discipline from an accredited university (or verify degree within 5 years of passing the exam).

stages.title: Stage 2: Financial Plan Development Capstone
stages.subtitle: Synthesis of client data into a deliverable financial plan

nodes.name: Financial Plan Development Capstone Course
nodes.description: Synthesize real-world client qualitative and quantitative data to develop, document, and present a comprehensive written financial plan demonstrating fiduciary mastery.
topics: Constructing Cash Flow, Balance Sheet & Net Worth Projections
Integrated Advisory Recommendations & Risk Management Integration
Written Financial Plan Presentation & Fiduciary Disclosure

nodes.name: CFP® Computer-Based Examination
nodes.format: 170 Multiple-Choice Questions (Standalone, Short Vignette, Complex Case Studies)
nodes.description: Comprehensive computer-based examination evaluating application and integration of the 7 Principal Knowledge Domains in complex client scenarios.
checklists: Complete official CFP Board mock practice exams
Master calculator keystrokes for TVM, amortization, and cash flows

stages.title: Stage 4: Experience, Fiduciary Ethics & Credential Award
stages.subtitle: 6,000 Hours Experience + Fiduciary Standards of Conduct

nodes.name: 6,000 Hours Qualifying Financial Planning Experience
nodes.description: Complete 6,000 hours of qualifying professional experience in the financial planning process (or 4,000 hours through an approved direct Apprenticeship model).

nodes.name: CFP Board Fiduciary Code of Ethics & Standards
nodes.description: Commit to act as a fiduciary at all times when providing financial advice to clients, placing the client's best interests above personal or firm gain.
topics: Fiduciary Duty of Care, Loyalty, and Following Client Instructions
Managing and Disclosing Conflicts of Interest
Practice Standards for the Financial Planning Process

nodes.name: CFP® Credential Conferred & Annual Renewal
nodes.description: Formal authorization to use the marks CFP® and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™. Requires 30 hours of CE every 2 years (including 2 hours of CFP Board approved ethics).
